label: node recovery
type: reintegrating a failed-over node into the cluster BEFORE it has been rebalanced out, in one of two modes - full or delta. Can be aborted before the rebalance that applies it.
evidence: After failover has occurred, before the failed over node has been rebalanced out of the cluster, the node can be _recovered_, and thereby reintegrated into the cluster.
There are two options for recovery, which are _full_ and _delta_.
Recovery can be aborted, by left-clicking on the **CANCEL ADD BACK** button.
note: The 'before it has been rebalanced out' window is the operative fact and is a workflow property, not a property of the node. Its two modes are promoted with it under the family exception - see server:full-recovery.
relates_to_competency_question: After a failover, in what window can the node be brought back, and in what modes?
